source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if NVMe RAID locate LED function works normally
1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot
2. Select NVMe adapter and locate NVMe SSD
3. Check locate LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Example Locate start command with controller/enclosure/slot variables and visual confirmation.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Locate command result and physical observation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; semantically matches Locate and keeps visual confirmation, but assumes controller/enclosure defaults and omits paired stop and insertion safety.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds stable target mapping, hot-plug gate, Locate start/stop, operator media and post-state.

original_test_intent: Insert the approved NVMe SSD, select it through the correct RAID/NVMe adapter, activate its supported Locate/UID function, and verify the visible indicator illuminates on the exact physical bay defined by the platform specification.
original_method: After operator insertion and stable serial-to-bay mapping, the agent issues paired vendor-supported Locate start/stop operations to the resolved adapter/enclosure/slot and captures command state; the operator directly observes and records the correct physical LED.
manual_activity: Physical SSD insertion and visual confirmation that the correct bay illuminates are explicit core acceptance steps. CLI start/stop is automatable but cannot replace either action, so the case is MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: Platform Locate/UID LED color, pattern and expected on/off behavior
SSD serial, adapter identity, chassis bay, backplane/enclosure and slot mapping
Supported insertion power state, hot-plug and ESD procedure
Controller-vendor Locate start, status and stop syntax/version
Operator/camera evidence window and recovery for a stuck or wrong LED
safety_requirements: Do not hot-insert unless the exact bay supports it and the operator is authorized.
Resolve controller/enclosure/slot from inventory; never assume controller or enclosure 0.
Show and approve the resolved SSD/bay before Locate activation.
Always include the matching stop action in the unchanged plan; do not leave Locate asserted.
Do not retry another slot automatically or initialize/format the drive after mismatch.
agent_execution_scope: Collect pre-state adapter/enclosure/slot/SSD identity and present it for confirmation.
Run the validated Locate start, state query and stop for the single approved target.
Timestamp controller/OS/BMC responses and correlate them with operator media.
Verify Locate is cleared and report Tool Result without claiming physical observation.
engineer_actions: Approve and physically insert the SSD under the platform procedure.
Confirm the resolved bay, visually observe Locate on/off and record photo/video.
Resolve wrong-bay or stuck-indicator conditions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Potentially applicable only after vendor/controller and target validation. The fallback enclosure 0 is unacceptable and a start-only example is incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the controller's documented paired Locate/UID start and stop commands against stable adapter/enclosure/slot identity, with readback when supported.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SSD insertion, adapter selection, Locate activation/inspection and 10/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.status: PAIRED LOCATE CONTROL WITH MANUAL BAY CONFIRMATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a serial-to-bay evidence card, use guarded start/status/stop operations, and capture synchronized before/on/off images of the mapped bay.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact NVMe adapter, backplane, controller utility and LED design.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record controller/backplane/BMC firmware, driver and utility version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Controller vendor Locate/UID command guide and platform LED/slot mapping specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable target resolution and mandatory cleanup without replacing visual evidence.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Validated start/stop syntax and physical bay map.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A successful CLI response proves command acceptance, not that the intended physical indicator operated.

project_override_considerations: The project selects one adapter/SSD/bay and may approve its controller-native terminology. The record must map that target explicitly and retain physical on/off observation.
expected_evidence: Specification and complete SSD/adapter/enclosure/slot/bay identity map
Operator insertion attestation and baseline physical LED state
Locate start/status/stop transcript with exact target and timestamps
Operator-attributed on/off photo/video, post-health, Tool Result and separate verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Item, procedure and criterion consistently describe specification-based Locate LED verification; missing concrete mapping and syntax are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation is unambiguous and becomes ready with the platform map, supported command and operator.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps its correct Locate concept but removes target defaults and adds the omitted stop path.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains stable identity and physical proof controls; changes the class to MANUAL ONLY because the acceptance observation is human.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly verifies cleanup state and separates command success from visible LED result.

review_improvement: Makes wrong-bay activation and stuck Locate state detectable while preserving the physical acceptance boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: Unlike adjacent Present/Busy/Fail cases, Locate is intentionally command-driven, so automation can produce the stimulus. The decisive result is still which physical bay lights, requiring manual visual evidence and MANUAL ONLY classification.
no_automatic_retry: Do not try adjacent slots or repeat Locate after mismatch. Issue the approved stop once, preserve evidence and escalate.
